newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ sees growth of 2.0 pct in yr to Mar 97.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ sees growth of 2.0 pct in yr to Mar 97.

text.p: The Reserve Bank in its six- monthly projections on Friday forecast New Zealand economic growth at 2.0 percent in the year to March 1997 and 2.4 percent in the year to March 1998.
On a March quarter to March quarter basis, the bank projected production based GDP growth rates of 2.0 percent in 1997 and 2.6 percent in 1998.
In its June monetary policy statement, the bank said the growth rate would slow on a point to point basis to between 2.0 percent and 2.5 percent in both the March 1997 and 1998 years.
